D: Axel returns to LA to hunt the gang that shot Captain Bogomil.
P: Serve dessert when Axel bluffs his way into the Playboy Mansion party.
S: Rodeo Drive bacon and gruyère quiches
Axel crashing the Beverly Hills party circuit

Bite-size shortcrust cases filled with smoky bacon, caramelised onion, gruyère and a just-set egg custard, finished with chives. Heat the oven to 180C. Cut 24 rounds from 3 sheets of shortcrust pastry and press into mini muffin trays. Fry 3 diced bacon rashers with 1 thinly sliced onion for 10 minutes until golden and divide between the cases with 80g grated gruyère. Whisk 3 eggs with 200ml cream, salt and pepper, pour into the cases and bake 15 minutes until just set. Top with snipped chives.
Baby vegetables with a creamy herb and anchovy dip
Baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and sugar snaps on ice with green goddess dressing (mayo, sour cream, parsley, tarragon, chives, anchovy, lemon).
Potato and cheese pierogi fried in butter with golden onions
Potato and cheese dumplings boiled then pan-fried in butter with onions, sour cream on the side.
M: Grilled rib eye with chimichurri and corn
Rib eyes and corn cobs off the coals, parsley chimichurri, potato salad
Rib eye steaks and corn on the cob over hot coals, chimichurri (parsley, oregano, garlic, chilli, vinegar, oil) and a big potato salad.
Room service club sandwich and fries
room service on someone else's account

Triple-decker toasted club of roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles with hot salted fries. Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, and salt them. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices white bread and spread with mayo. Layer each sandwich toast, 100g sliced roast chicken and lettuce, toast, 2 bacon rashers and sliced tomato, toast. Pin each with 4 skewers, cut into 4 triangles and serve with the fries.
W: Banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, fudge, nuts and a cherry
Split banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: Tequila and orange juice with grenadine sinking to the bottom

Tequila and fresh orange juice poured over ice, with grenadine sinking to the bottom for the sunrise, finished with an orange wheel and cherry. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml tequila and 150ml fresh orange juice to each and stir. Slowly pour 15ml grenadine down the inside of each glass so it sinks and fades up through the juice. Don't stir again. Garnish each with an orange wheel and a cocktail cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Dip up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the mayonnaise, sour cream, herbs, anchovies and lemon juice until green and smooth.
Cut the vegetables into sticks or halves.
Arrange the vegetables on ice around the bowl of dip.
Slice the onions.
Fry the onions in butter until golden.
Boil the pierogi, then drain.
Add the pierogi to the onions and fry until crisp on each side.
Serve with sour cream and chopped dill.

steps.text: Blitz the parsley, oregano, garlic, chilli, vinegar and oil for the chimichurri.
Boil the potatoes until tender and drain.
Dress the potatoes with mayonnaise and sliced spring onion.
Grill the rib eyes and corn over hot coals.
Rest the steaks briefly and serve with chimichurri.
Split the bananas lengthways into long dishes and add a scoop of each ice cream.
Melt the chocolate with some of the cream and pour over.
Whip the rest of the cream.
Top with whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
Fill tall glasses with ice. Add tequila and orange juice to each and stir.
Slowly pour grenadine down the inside of each glass so it sinks. Do not stir again.
Garnish with an orange wheel and a cherry.

s.note: Baby vegetables with a creamy herb and anchovy dip
s.how: Blitz 100g mayo, 100g sour cream, a handful of parsley, a few tarragon leaves, chives, 2 anchovies and lemon juice until green and smooth. Arrange baby carrots, radishes, cucumber and sugar snaps on ice around the bowl.

s.note: Potato and cheese pierogi fried in butter with golden onions
s.how: Boil 750g frozen potato and cheese pierogi for 4 minutes and drain. Fry 2 sliced onions in 50g butter for 10 minutes until golden, add the pierogi and fry 3 minutes a side until crisp. Serve with 200g sour cream and chopped dill.

m.n: Grilled rib eye with chimichurri and corn
m.note: Rib eyes and corn cobs off the coals, parsley chimichurri, potato salad
m.how: Blitz parsley, 1 tsp oregano, 3 garlic cloves, a chilli, 60ml red wine vinegar and 125ml oil for chimichurri. Boil 1kg potatoes and dress with mayo and spring onion. Grill 4 rib eyes and 4 corn cobs over hot coals and serve together.

w.note: Banana with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, fudge, nuts and a cherry
w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways into four long dishes. Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream and pour over. Top with whipped cream, chopped nuts and a cherry.

d.note: Tequila and orange juice with grenadine sinking to the bottom
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml tequila and 150ml fresh orange juice to each and stir. Slowly pour 15ml grenadine down the inside of each glass so it sinks and fades up through the juice. Don't stir again. Garnish each with an orange wheel and a cocktail cherry.
